outcome: Amniotic fluid disorders (oligohydramnios, polyhydramnios, meconium-stained amniotic fluid)
cohort: Pregnant women who gave birth between 2011 and 2012
finding: Grand multiparity was associated with inadequate prenatal care, maternal anemia, and amniotic fluid disorders, but not with an increased risk of diabetic disorders, hypertension, or cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Grand multiparity was associated with a lower rate of instrumental deliveries.
